tagline: Premium collection: a round seal pup and a penguin as pets (sitting up they reach your shoulder), two sets of wings, a pompom beanie, an igloo backpack with a resident seal, a soft aurora ring and an HD snowfall cape. Everything 3D, HD textures, animated – with the new optional states (sprint, glide, idle_long, happy) and wings that make room for a backpack (offsetWhen).

vibey:polar_seal.story: idle 13 s: breathe → blink → head tilt → sit up and clap three times (hearts + soft squeak) → look around → roll over (snow puff) → shake. walk 1 s: galumph, galumph. sprint: fast belly scoot with whirling flippers and snow spray. glide: superman with spread flippers. fly: flapping superman. sneak: shy, blushing loaf. happy (while you play an emote): hop-hop-clap above the head with hearts. idle_long (you stood still ~10 s): lies down for a nap, eyes shut, 3D Zs rise.

vibey:polar_penguin.story: idle 16 s: look around → happy flipper flap with hops → a fish appears in the beak, tilt, toss, gulp (heart) → preen → little side-to-side dance. walk 0.6 s: waddle. sprint: belly slide with kicking feet. glide: superman, flippers spread wide. fly: frantic flapping. sneak: ducks into the scarf. happy: hop-hop, flapping like mad, heart. idle_long: dozes off standing, head sinks into the scarf, Zs.

vibey:polar_igloo_backpack.story: idle 8 s: the seal pup pops out of the door (snow puff), looks left and right, blinks, waves a flipper, ducks back in; the pennant flutters. walk: the pack bounces, the pennant flaps.

vibey:polar_pompom_beanie.story: Calm: soft purple knit, a ribbed cuff, one clean snow-white pompom. idle 3 s: a damped boing with squash and stretch. walk: bounces with the steps. fly: the pompom streams back.

vibey:polar_aurora_ring.story: Three thin, curved ribbons of soft light (translucent + emissive, 12-frame interpolated strip, alpha fades out at every edge). Phase-shifted waves fold, lift, lean and stretch the segments so the curtains flow; the aurora turns once in 16 s, three crystal snowflakes orbit, sparkles rise.

vibey:polar_aurora_wings.story: Two soft aurora curtains per side, each a chain of 2 px segments with one continuous curtain texture. idle: slow ripple. fly: big flowing strokes with a sparkle stream. glide: swept back, streaming. sneak: folded in. The crystal knots sit at the outer shoulder blades; with a backpack they lift 2 px and move 4 px back (offsetWhen) and glow right beside the igloo top.

vibey:polar_owl_wings.story: Arm → forearm → hand bones, lesser + greater coverts and alula as scalloped layers, 5 secondaries and 5 primaries as separate feather bones. idle: folded angel-style with a slow breath. walk: gentle bob. fly: one big clean flap, then a long glide. glide (elytra): wide soaring wings. sneak: tucked in tight. The roots sit at the outer shoulder blades; with a backpack the wings lift 2.5 px, move 6 px back and tilt 10° (offsetWhen), so they hang beside the igloo instead of behind it.

vibey:polar_snowfall_cape.story: HD 4× cape texture, 8 frames: aurora ripples, stars twinkle, snow falls in a seamless loop, the penguin waves, the seal blinks. Purple fleece lining with teal snowflakes; the elytra get the night sky.

rounds.title: Runde 2 · vorher / nachher
rounds.note: Robbe kleiner (pet.scale 1.2 → 0.85): liegend etwa hüfthoch, aufgerichtet knapp unter der Schulter – so groß wie der Pinguin. Flügel + Iglu-Rucksack: die Flügelwurzeln sitzen jetzt außen an den Schulterblättern; mit Rucksack heben sich die Eulenflügel 2,5 px, rücken nur 6 px statt 9 px nach hinten und kippen 10° (offsetWhen), die Polarlicht-Flügel heben sich 2 px und rücken 4 px statt 8 px nach hinten – sie sitzen seitlich am Iglu statt dahinter, ohne ineinander zu schneiden.

notes: Cosmetic animation states (client 0.2.2, AvatarDraw.COSMETIC_ANIMS / StateWeights): idle, walk, fly, sneak plus the optional sprint, glide (elytra or a long fall), idle_long (standing still ~10 s) and happy (the owner plays an emote). Weights follow a capped priority (glide > fly > sprint > walk > sneak > happy > idle_long > idle) and never sum above 1. Bundles without the new states play walk / fly / idle there, like 0.2.1.
The optional states start their animation from the beginning when the state begins (per avatar); idle / walk / fly / sneak keep the global clock.
cosmetic.offsetWhen moves an item's root bones while another slot is worn (eased in/out): both wings lift and move a little back so they sit beside the igloo backpack.

Emissive + translucent bones (the aurora) render with the engine's own soft pipeline on 1.21.11 and 26.1 (other versions: vanilla emissive): full-bright, no per-face shading, no depth writes and no 0.1 alpha cutout, so the light fades out smoothly.
Events of idle always run (also while walking); the other states' events only above 50 % weight.
Eyelids, the fish, the peeking pup and the nap Zs rest hidden inside the model and are moved out by animation offsets, so they disappear by themselves when another state takes over.
